Name: Unofficial Seasonal Haley 1.6
Author: cowboylikeskype
Description:
All credit goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/71935143]stanloona420[/url] as they are the original creator of this mod! I've just made a few outfits compatible with version 1.6.

The only outfits that are available are the following; Spring, Summer and Fall. The winter, beach and festival outfits might come in a future update (if i can figure out how to put them in) and that's only if the original creator hasn't updated their mod yet! I'm new to modding but I tried my best and I hope every Haley lover is satisfied.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11389?tab=description](CP) Haley Revised and Seasonal Outfits at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url] (The Original)
